title: excel-inflow-policy-registry/1.0
description: P2.7 — versioned registry of model-owned assumption families. Every family binds to {policy_id, version, owned_assumption, evidence_hierarchy}; case-level policy objects carry the binding and a version change is receipt-visible. Vocabularies are the EXISTING ones: evidence_hierarchy rungs come from FORECAST_AUTHORITY_PRIORITY (scripts/lib/forecast_authority.mjs), owned_assumption modules from assets/canonical-model-graph-v2.json and schedule roles from SCHEDULE_PRODUCER_BY_ROLE (scripts/lib/forecast_producer_contract.mjs). Cross-vocabulary membership is enforced by scripts/lib/policy_registry.mjs at load, never repaired.

policy_id.description: Stable family identifier; must equal the entry's key in entries.

version.description: Registry version of this family's owned assumption. Bumping it changes every sealed policy binding that carries it — receipt-visible by construction.

binding_status.description: bound: the case-level policy object carries a stamped policy_binding end to end. declared_only: coverage is declared here, binding is follow-on work (named in programme/P2.7_issue_card.md).

scope.description: model: the assumption lives in the canonical model graph. runtime: an execution-budget family with no model module (module is null).

module.description: One of assets/canonical-model-graph-v2.json modules when scope is model; null when scope is runtime. Membership enforced by the loader.

schedule_roles.description: Schedule roles this family's assumption drives; each must be a SCHEDULE_PRODUCER_BY_ROLE key. Empty when the family owns no schedule role directly.

evidence_hierarchy.description: Ordered rungs, strongest first, each a FORECAST_AUTHORITY_PRIORITY method with strictly increasing priority number (weaker as you descend). Empty ONLY for system_owned engineering constants that no case evidence resolves today.

owner_module.description: Repository anchor for the family's owning code or contract region.

case_binding.description: The model-case key whose object carries the stamped policy_binding, or null while binding is declared_only.

system_owned.description: True only for engineering-owned constants (numerics, budgets, tolerances, materiality literals). Exactly these entries may carry an empty evidence_hierarchy.

external_version_identity.description: Pre-existing version identity the family already carries in code or assets (e.g. excel-inflow-tax-rate-policy/1.0); recorded, never replaced.
